name: Show-open — In Focus
description: The flagship corpus-v2 integration bumper (dex cz213ft7): one continuous ~8s full-frame show-open that exercises the shipped families together — the dimensional depth stage with a live camera push + slow rack focus (the title arrives INTO focus over the neutral atmosphere-slate backdrop), a lower-third episode plate riding its own near-focal depth plane, per-character title choreography, reading-order Cascade (surface → kicker → title → plate), an ambient sound bed with a motion-emitted impact on the title land, and the opaque ProRes lane. Deliberately PACK-NEUTRAL: content belongs to no channel and the composition carries NO appearance chrome — typography colours are omitted so each Pack's core fill/ink drive them (ADR-0038), effects[] is empty so each Pack supplies its own screen physics (syntax grain / crt-terminal scanline+bloom chrome, appended because the piece is opaque). Ships as one recipe under two opposite Packs — see show-open-in-focus-crt. Spine is a live depth-stage timeline (not an ADR-0026 snapshot wipe — that path can't carry a live camera move).
